topic: Hunter/gatherer split for research-stack v3, with Jev (TypeSafe) as the gatherer's optional scorer
decision: How should research-stack v3 implement a hunter/gatherer split, and should Jev be the gatherer's optional scorer (and with what thresholds and guards)?
done_when: Every sub-question has 2+ corroborating kept cards or 1 authoritative kept card
out_of_scope: Replacing Claude as the report writer
Non-research uses of Jev (lead scoring, DMs)

sub_questions.Q1: Jev API contract: endpoint, question types, limits (context, rate), pricing, access status (early access/waitlist), versioning, official vs third-party hosts
sub_questions.Q2: Independent evidence of Jev's accuracy and calibration as a judge or relevance scorer, and where it fails
sub_questions.Q3: What a research subagent (hunter) should hand a curator: evidence formats, provenance, raw notes; lessons from production deep-research systems
sub_questions.Q4: Confidence-based routing: cascade/escalation design, picking keep/drop thresholds, calibrating cutoffs on labelled data, cost/quality of LLM cascades
sub_questions.Q5: Data and safety risk of sending research text to TypeSafe: retention/privacy terms, client or internal data, prompt injection against judge/classifier models
